text: The FC Cincinnati front sponsor is Mercy Health, the Ohio and Kentucky ministry whose own site describes it as one ministry of Catholic healthcare across those states and part of what became Bon Secours Mercy Health in the 2018 merger of the two systems. It is a not-for-profit, so there is no shareholder owner and no state stake. Human-rights relevance: Catholic healthcare ethics and US hospital labour, nothing state-linked.
